public_rationale: The benchmark published on December 18, 2024 reports that its strongest tested agent completed 24% of 175 simulated workplace tasks [e1]. This shows limits on those tasks, but neither counts practically useful applications nor establishes how many were commonly advertised [e1]. It therefore cannot supply the missing comparison needed to assess the complete claim [e1].
limitations: The claim identifies no advertised comparison set, common unit for counting applications, or standard for practical reliability.
The existence of useful applications is separately testable, but this simulated-task benchmark does not establish their prevalence in practice.
